## Integrity (HARD RULES — non-negotiable)
- Close a `sorry` ONLY with a genuine proof. NEVER discharge it with a device that makes the file compile without actually proving the statement: no new `axiom`, no `admit`, no unproven auxiliary `axiom`/lemma cited by `exact`, no `native_decide`/`decide` on a claim that is not genuinely decidable, no `@[implemented_by]`/`@[extern]` or `sorry` hidden inside a helper. Introducing an axiom for the hard part is a FAILURE, not a pass — it silently injects an assumption into the library.
- If a declaration is genuinely beyond you this turn, LEAVE its `sorry` exactly as it is (do not replace it with a fake discharge) and report honestly that you could not prove it, naming the decl and the concrete blocker (missing lemma, unclear step, integrability side-condition, etc.). A `sorry` left in place and reported is the CORRECT outcome when you don't know the proof; a fake discharge is never acceptable.
- The only CausalSmith imports you may add or retain are same-run modules under `CausalSmith.Substrate.MarkedVariableOrderFactorialCovariance.*`. Paper/research modules and helpers from other runs are forbidden dependencies. If such a dependency is needed, leave the blocker and report it instead of copying the definition.

Lean files live under: <repo-root>/CausalSmith/CausalSmith/Substrate/MarkedVariableOrderFactorialCovariance
Target declarations: matchingNormalization_of_mem, normalizedOrderedProductStatistic_mul_expansion, integral_normalizedOrderedProductStatistic_mul, mergedProductMoment_empty, centeredCrossMoment_normalizedOrderedProductStatistic

## Required final verification
BUILD GREEN BEFORE YOU STOP. Do not return until you have built every Lean module you edited and
confirmed 0 errors and no `sorry`/`admit` that you did not deliberately leave as a disclosed
blocker. Run the actual targeted build (`lake build <edited modules>` from the `CausalSmith`
package) as your LAST step and read its output; do not trust a proof merely because it looks right
in the editor. A proof that does not compile is not done. If you report a genuine blocker, every
other edited module must still build cleanly.

WARNING-FLOOD GUARD. Lake can emit enough replay warnings to truncate the terminal before its final
diagnostics and exit status. For the LAST verification, capture the complete build output to a
temporary file while preserving the build status, then print an explicit `BUILD_EXIT=<status>` and
the diagnostic tail. Do not treat a completed tool call or truncated warning-only output as success:
return only after the explicit preserved build status is `BUILD_EXIT=0`.

## Instructions
Fill exactly the five sorries in `CausalSmith/Substrate/MarkedVariableOrderFactorialCovariance/Expansion.lean`. Do not import any paper/research module or modify `Bounds.lean`, upstream files, or `plan.md`.

For the pointwise identity, classify each pair of injective tuples by the partial matching `t i = q j`. Injectivity makes the selected-coordinate correspondence an equivalence. Use `PartialMatching.mergedIndex_card`, denominator positivity from `hrn`/`hsn`, and handle merged cardinality greater than `n` explicitly rather than assuming it away.

For the integral identity, integrate the finite expansion. When `Fintype.card M.MergedIndex ≤ n`, apply `integral_normalizedFiniteKernelStatistic`; when it exceeds `n`, show the relevant falling factorial/tuple family is zero. For the empty matching, reindex its merged product law to the product of the `Fin r` and `Fin s` laws using Mathlib's finite-product measurable equivalences, then use Fubini/`integral_prod_mul`. Derive the centered identity from marginal unbiasedness, uniqueness of the size-zero matching, empty-moment factorization, and a finite-sum partition into zero and positive sizes.

Search Mathlib/Causalean before inventing measure-transport lemmas. Leave no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, or `native_decide`. Verify with direct source checking and `lake build CausalSmith.Substrate.MarkedVariableOrderFactorialCovariance`; grep the edited source for forbidden proof holes and run `#print axioms` for all five target declarations. Report the exact verification commands and results.

Use the lean-lsp MCP tools to develop/check your proof (diagnostics/goal). When done, output a
SHORT plain-text report: which decls you genuinely closed, which you left as `sorry` (with the

confirm you introduced NO `axiom`/`admit`/other non-proof discharge. No JSON required.
